entries.title: Healing Classrooms (5.2) - Connecting to Student's Lived Experiences
entries.description:
Healing Classrooms Video 5.2 shows how to create lesson plans that are pertinent to students' everyday lives.  The video also demonstrates specific activities that can help students express their opinions and connect to peers' experiences.

This video is one of the multimedia resources of the International Rescue Committee (IRC)'s Healing Classrooms Initiative. Additional materials including training modules, printouts and advice on leading Healing Classrooms workshops are available for free online at http://healingclassrooms.org/.

A Facilitator's Guide accompanies the videos. To obtain copies of the Facilitator's Guide or for more information about the IRC's Healing Classrooms Initiative, please email us at children@rescue.org.
